basic_info.description: Welcome to this stunningly remodeled 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom semi detached home located in the heart of San Francisco's highly sought-after Outer Sunset neighborhood. Blending modern design with coastal charm, this home offers the perfect balance of comfort, style, and unbeatable location.   Step inside to discover an open-concept living and dining area filled with natural light, featuring new floors, recessed lighting, and a sleek, new kitchen with stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and custom cabinetry. Two full bathrooms featuring designer tiles and modern finishes. The spacious layout includes three generously sized bedrooms with large closets, perfect for families, home offices, or guests. Downstairs, a versatile bonus space opens up to a private, low-maintenance backyard  ideal for entertaining or relaxing after a day at the beach.There is also a designated laundry area with a new washer and dryer, a mudroom, and plenty of storage space.  Enjoy morning walks to Ocean Beach, just steps away, or explore the vibrant local scene of Taraval and Noriega with an array of cafes, restaurants, shops, and parks right around the corner.  Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a turn-key home in one of San Francisco's most beloved beachside neighborhoods.
